description: Source code for the VolcanoFeatureStep class, which integrates Volcano scheduling with Spark on Kubernetes, providing functionality to generate and configure Volcano PodGroups within Spark's Kubernetes deployment.

classes.name: VolcanoFeatureStep
classes.description: A class that adds Volcano scheduling support to Spark on Kubernetes, managing PodGroup creation and pod configuration.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the VolcanoFeatureStep with either a KubernetesDriverConf or KubernetesExecutorConf.

methods.name: getAdditionalPreKubernetesResources
methods.description: Generates Volcano PodGroup resources based on configuration, for inclusion before Kubernetes resource creation.

methods.name: configurePod
methods.description: Adds Volcano-specific annotations to a SparkPod to associate it with a PodGroup.

methods.name: getPodGroupConfigByTemplateFile
methods.description: Loads a PodGroup configuration from a specified template file.

methods.name: getPodGroupByTemplateJson
methods.description: Loads a PodGroup configuration from a JSON string.
